0022600205.text: The Pistons (6-3, 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East) host the Wizards (4-6, 9th in the East) in Detroit's 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with Detroit on a two-game losing streak after going 6-3 in its last nine. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Washington is without Bilal Coulibaly (hand), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 117-95 win in Washington on March 19.
